summary: Validated iteration-11 geocoding features end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest passed (auth, single-lookup, 404 on unresolvable, auto-geocode on create for Bridgetown+Kingston, explicit-coords-preserved, update auto-geocode, bulk-backfill shape/auth, CRUD regression, categories, bulk-delete). Frontend: admin login, Add Provider modal opens, MiniMapPicker (data-testid=mini-map-picker) renders, 'Find from address' button geocodes 'Bridgetown, Barbados' -> lat=13.097783, lng=-59.618418 (in expected range) and populates field-latitude/field-longitude; clicking the mini map updates the fields (13.1046,-59.6080). Directory /directory Map view renders providers-map, initial state showed 4 markers/2 clusters for local TEST_GEO_MAP providers; zooming out collapsed everything to 1 cluster of 27. map-unmapped-note reads '27 mapped · 73 need coordinates' — providers without coords are excluded from the layer. auto-locate-btn present on admin dashboard. 3 TEST_GEO_MAP_* providers cleaned up.
action_items: Naming discrepancy (non-blocking): review request references data-testid="geocode-address-btn", but the code (MiniMapPicker.jsx line 50) uses data-testid="find-from-address-btn". Button works correctly; consider aligning testid to spec or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py geocode_address() uses the sync `requests.get` inside an async endpoint plus `await asyncio.sleep(1.0)` in bulk backfill — this blocks the event loop for up to ~12s per Nominatim call. Bulk backfill of 40 providers can freeze the worker for ~50s. Consider `httpx.AsyncClient` or run_in_executor.
ProviderBase in server.py (~lines 162-164) still declares `country: Optional[str] = ""` twice (leftover from prior iteration). Duplicate declaration, safe to delete.

geocode_address swallows all exceptions and returns None silently. On upstream Nominatim outages, callers get providers saved without coords and no signal. Consider surfacing a warning field so admins know geocoding was attempted-and-failed.

backfill_geocode has no upper bound guard beyond .limit(40); no way for admin to see progress or resume. UI 'Auto-locate' button just calls it once — for 73 unmapped providers admin has to click Auto-locate multiple times. Consider returning cursor state or looping in the endpoint (with respectful pacing).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created and deleted TEST_GEO_* providers within each test. Playwright run created 3 TEST_GEO_MAP_* providers and deleted them at teardown. DB left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend geocode tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_geocode.py. Nominatim hits are ~1-3s each; full pytest run ~59s. If Nominatim throttles/returns empty, auto-geocode tests may flake — retry once. Frontend testid on the geocode picker button is `find-from-address-btn` (not `geocode-address-btn` as some specs may say).
